name: Undertab
description: Browse & search history, clear this site's cookies/cache/history, see today's visit stats plus last-time-browsed and browser-open detection, block/unblock sites (with a full-page dashboard view), save sites into categories, an hourly local-only screenshot timeline (1h Snapshot), a live Time Tracker with a per-site donut chart and daily time logs, a Tabs panel to pause/resume open tabs, a right-click menu for quick block/save/search/nuke/pause/stats, track when you've cleared things, and switch between light/dark mode.
